name: web_search
description: PROACTIVE for live public facts. Look up current information on the public web (news, weather, sports, prices, anything that needs live data). Use when: answer needs up-to-date public information. Do NOT use when: Mac device state (get_mac_status), controlling Mac/browser (mac_run_actions / browser_run_actions), or pure knowledge you already know without live data.
